donatePage.amountNote: Any amount helps. These are examples of what a gift adds to, not exact prices.

presets.food: Helps fill a 17 kg food box for a displaced family
presets.baby: Contributes to a baby box for a child aged 0–5
presets.medicine: Helps buy medicines for a hospital
presets.shelter: Helps feed an animal shelter for a week

donatePage.qrAlt: QR code for a bank transfer to the fund
donatePage.jarText: Top up the fund's jar with any Ukrainian card.

safe.a: Yes. Your transfer goes straight from your bank to the details published by the fund, with no middlemen. The fund is officially registered in Ukraine, EDRPOU 44749163.

receipt.a: Write to us on Instagram with the date and amount of your transfer. We'll confirm we received it and tell you what it went to.

companies.a: Yes. Companies can transfer to the same details or become a partner of a project. Write to us on Instagram and we'll agree on the details.

where.a: To the fund's projects: food and baby boxes for displaced families, medicines for hospitals, help for defenders and animal shelters. Every project is on the site, with photos.

thanks.title: Thank you for your help
thanks.lead: Your transfer turns into food, medicines and care for people who need them right now. We're grateful you're with us.

receive.title: We receive it
receive.text: The transfer reaches the fund's account, usually within a few banking days.

spend.title: It goes to a project
spend.text: We add it to a current project: food and baby boxes, medicines, help for defenders or animals.

report.title: We show the result
report.text: We post photos from every delivery on Instagram and on the site.

thanks.shareLead: One message can bring the next donation. Share the fund's site with people who care.
thanks.shareText: I support Together We Made Power, a Ukrainian charity fund. Join me:
